description: Water Distribution Network Pipeline Shape File for the City of Lahan, Nepal (Updated May 2023) is a data set deposited in ORDA - The University of Sheffield Research Data Catalogue and Repository by its authors Richard Collins, Matthew MacRorie. This shape file contains the water distribution system pipe information for the network in the City of Lahan, Nepal as of May 2023. This network information is to be considered a best guess and not definitive. Coverage: national (NP); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 78195 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
